scope: F2 fold-0 screen (saved-OOF study, no new model training). Cross-fold robust ensemble: select member subsets that are robust ACROSS the 5 primary folds rather than best on fold-0.

protocol.member_pool: all single-model OOF entries in the store with family in (lgbm, xgb, cat, realmlp, tabm, lgbm_soft) that have a full 5-fold OOF (no blend entries, no duplicates).
protocol.selection: greedy forward selection (max 8 members) maximizing the MINIMUM per-fold AUC of the equal-logit blend across folds 1-4 (robustness objective on TRAIN folds only); fold 0 is never used for selection.
protocol.evaluation: fold-0 AUC of the selected robust blend; port_delta vs route_ref; Spearman vs route_ref; also report the fold-0 AUC of the same-size fold-0-greedy (cheating, diagnostic-only) subset for the robustness-vs-peak contrast.

non_goals: No new model training; saved OOF only.
